commitPolicy: The run-record file is committed last, so its own commit hash is intentionally represented as SELF; final external run summary records the resulting branch HEAD.

implementationCommits.message: feat: add physical facade glazing gasket assembly
qa: define glazing gasket construction and evidence contract
qa: bind glazing gasket metadata to danchi domain

priorityReasoning.selectedGap: The generated facade already had real rough openings, aluminum sash geometry, two depth-separated glass panes and 4 mm glass edge thickness, but no explicit glass-to-sash glazing gasket around the 60 apartment panes. At 4K this can make glazing read as floating in an extrusion and weakens geometry/contact/material plausibility exactly in facade_center, construction_depth and sash_rail_response evidence.
priorityReasoning.whyBeforeMoreExpansion: The missing interface affects construction fidelity, PBR material separation, grazing-light contact response, repeated-module perception and LOD stability in existing locked benchmark crops. It therefore has higher expected gate impact than adding a new unrelated prop.
priorityReasoning.renderPointPolicy: No Visual Fidelity points are awarded from this source-side implementation. Contact, z-fighting, black-halo risk, repetition, shimmer and LOD pop remain render-only judgments.

manufactureInstallationReconstruction.components: Existing 1.03 m x 1.46 m apartment glass panes plus a separate dark elastomer perimeter captured by four LOD0 gasket bars per pane; existing aluminum frame/sash, track and 4 mm glass-edge geometry remain authoritative surrounding parts.
manufactureInstallationReconstruction.dimensionsThickness: 10 mm visible gasket face and 10 mm modeled depth are conservative benchmark reconstruction assumptions; nominal glass thickness remains 4 mm. The dimensions are not claimed as an identified historical product section.
manufactureInstallationReconstruction.materialsFinish: Canonical dry MAT_WindowRubber EPDM/rubber family: dark charcoal, high roughness, dielectric/zero metallic, no emission or baked highlight, metric 18 repeats/m texture response.
manufactureInstallationReconstruction.mounting: The gasket follows each of the two sliding leaves at its actual pane depth and sits immediately outside the pane perimeter, closing the prior glass-to-frame visual void without adding gameplay collision.
manufactureInstallationReconstruction.interfacesGapsSeals: LOD0 bars touch at boundaries rather than crossing the broad pane face; the assembly remains separate from the lower track/drainage route and from the rough-opening perimeter seal.
manufactureInstallationReconstruction.orientationExposure: Vertical exterior-facing but partly recessed/sheltered sash interface in dry midsummer benchmark conditions.
manufactureInstallationReconstruction.aging: Only subdued UV/recess grime/contact accumulation metadata; no ferrous rust and no arbitrary random dirt story.
manufactureInstallationReconstruction.geometryVsMaterial: Perimeter thickness/contact/corner meeting and pane depth are geometry. Fine rubber grain and roughness breakup remain material microstructure.
manufactureInstallationReconstruction.lod: LOD0=240 separate chamfered bars, LOD1=60 volumetric rings, LOD2=60 front-ring proxies, LOD3=60 narrower front-ring proxies; one animated-crossfade LODGroup uses 0.18/0.08/0.03/0.008 screen-relative thresholds.

externalResearch.source: LIXIL PRO-SE double sliding window specification
externalResearch.use: Family-level evidence that Japanese building sliding-sash systems define physical glazing grooves; not used to identify the benchmark sash product.
Family-level evidence that sash drainage/condensation interfaces are separate service components; benchmark dimensions remain conservative reconstruction assumptions.

staticChecks: All new implementation paths are below UnityProject; Godot was not modified.
No base merge was performed; compare merge-base remained the starting HEAD.
The Danchi metadata domain now explicitly links facade_glazing_gasket_contract.json and names glazing gaskets in interface/geometry/LOD policy.

Source QA requires canonical EPDM material, no metallic response/emission, no colliders, no stock Cube/Plane/Quad mesh, exact LOD counts and transforms, metric phase-diverse UVs, and cause-based LOD0 weathering metadata.
Source/contract explicitly award zero Visual Fidelity points and keep render verification pending.

renderRisksToInspect: 10 mm gasket could become an over-dark halo in frontal 4K even if construction is valid.
gasket/glass edge contact could reveal a hairline gap, interpenetration or z-fighting in oblique/grazing crops.
eight UV phase bins may still be visually insufficient across 60 panes if microstructure has a strong recognizable motif.
narrow LOD2/LOD3 front rings can shimmer or cross-fade visibly at subpixel width despite structurally valid LOD policy.
actual EPDM roughness/normal intensity depends on generated material assets and must be verified in Unity, not inferred from metadata.
